name: YoVoice Voice Constellation TOTP Challenge
purpose: Design handoff reference only; do not load this JSON at runtime.

geometry.availableWidthDefinition: The outer content-slot LayoutBuilder maxWidth after page padding but before applying the inner componentMaxWidth cap; not the viewport width and not the already-capped stage width.
geometry.componentHeightDefinition: Includes the motion canvas and one 42px status slot.
geometry.decorativeDigitTextScale: Fixed at the base AppTypography.headlineMedium size; these six glyphs are ExcludeSemantics duplicates of the one fully scalable semantic input.

colors.note: Use AppPalette/Theme semantic roles at runtime. These hex values are the current dark brand reference only.

curves.success: C1 handoff: orbit-to-brake cubic Bezier seeded from screen-space velocity; zero-velocity smootherstep for brake-to-wave and wave-to-collapse

interaction.autoSubmit: Edge-triggered on a transition from fewer than 6 to exactly 6 digits, after 120ms; all paths use one single-flight guard.
interaction.routeBackAllowed: Only in stable editing/retry-ready state; locked from accepted submit through controlled success pop or completed error return.
interaction.fastResponse: Capture each rendered element's position, size, radius, opacity, phase and velocity; interpolate success/error from that snapshot without an angle or canonical-layout reset.
interaction.rateLimitRetry: Preserve the code and require a deliberate manual retry; do not invent a local cooldown timer.

errorPolicy.invalidCode: Return to row, shake, show error, clear code after feedback, and restore focus. Never auto-retry.
errorPolicy.network: Return to row without shake, preserve code, use warning treatment, and allow manual retry.
errorPolicy.tooManyRequests: Return to row without auto-retry, preserve code, and show the existing mapped message.

reducedMotion.verifying: Keep the row static at 0.7 opacity and show Verifying code.
reducedMotion.success: Crossfade the row to the success badge in 120 ms.
reducedMotion.error: Change semantic error colour in 100 ms with no shake.
